name: status-indicator
title: Status Indicator
description: A versatile status indicator for avatars supporting top (verified, pin, favorite, add, remove, notification) and bottom (online, offline, busy, away, company) positions.

docs.lead: Status indicators designed for avatar corners. Top-position variants include verified badge, pin, favorite, add, remove, and notification. Bottom-position variants include online, offline, busy, away, and company logo.

examples.title: Top Variants
examples.description: Status indicators for the top-right corner: verified badge, pin, favorite, add, remove, and notification.
examples.code:
import * as StatusIndicator from '@/components/ui/status-indicator'

<StatusIndicator.Root status="verified" />
<StatusIndicator.Root status="pin" />
<StatusIndicator.Root status="favorite" />
<StatusIndicator.Root status="add" />
<StatusIndicator.Root status="remove" />
<StatusIndicator.Root status="notification" />

examples.title: Bottom Variants
examples.description: Status indicators for the bottom-right corner: online, offline, busy, away, and company. The company variant accepts children for a custom logo.
examples.code: import * as StatusIndicator from '@/components/ui/status-indicator'

api.name: StatusIndicator.Root
api.description: The status indicator element. Renders a default icon based on the status variant. Pass children to override the default content (useful for company logos).

props.name: status
props.description: The type of status indicator to display.
